encounters.chief_complaint: High fever, chills and dry cough since 2 days. Generalized body weakness.
encounters.diagnosis: Acute Viral Upper Respiratory Tract Infection (URTI) with Reactive Myalgia
encounters.clinical_findings: Pharynx erythematous, tonsils non-enlarged. Clear bilateral vesicular breath sounds. S1/S2 heard normal.
encounters.doctor_notes: Patient presents with acute low-grade fever and myalgia. Conservative antipyretic therapy advised.
encounters.lifestyle_advice: Steam inhalation twice daily, drink at least 2.5L clean water, avoid cold exposure.

encounters.chief_complaint: Severe throbbing occipital headache, blurred near vision, dizziness and palpitations.
encounters.clinical_findings: Elevated blood pressure 162/98 mmHg. Bilateral temporal pulse bounding. Neurological cranial screen intact.
encounters.doctor_notes: Elevated baseline BP. Initiated Telmisartan 40mg + Amlodipine 5mg. Scheduled 14-day retinopathy review.
encounters.lifestyle_advice: Low sodium DASH diet (<2g salt/day), daily blood pressure charting morning and evening.

encounters.chief_complaint: Acute periumbilical abdominal cramps, 4 episodes of watery diarrhea and nausea.
encounters.diagnosis: Acute Infectious Gastroenteritis with Mild Dehydration
encounters.clinical_findings: Abdomen soft with diffuse mild umbilical tenderness, hyperactive borborygmi, oral mucosa dry.
encounters.doctor_notes: History of outside meal 24h ago. Started oral rehydration salts and empiric gut antibiotic.
encounters.lifestyle_advice: Strict BRAT diet (Banana, Rice, Applesauce, Toast). Consume 1 liter ORS every 4-6 hours.

encounters.chief_complaint: Routine 3-month Type 2 Diabetes follow-up and prescription refill.
encounters.diagnosis: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus - Stable Glycemic Control
encounters.clinical_findings: Fasting blood glucose 118 mg/dL, HbA1c 6.8%. Peripheral pedal pulses palpable, no diabetic foot sores.
encounters.doctor_notes: Optimal medication adherence. Refilled Metformin 500mg and Glimepiride 1mg for 30 days.
encounters.lifestyle_advice: Continue 30 minutes brisk morning walk. Avoid refined carbohydrate snacks.

encounters.chief_complaint: Persistent sore throat, painful swallowing (odynophagia) and mild ear pain for 3 days.
encounters.clinical_findings: Marked pharyngeal erythema with tonsillar exudate. Tender anterior cervical lymphadenopathy bilaterally.
encounters.doctor_notes: Commenced oral Amoxicillin/Clavulanate 625mg for 5 days. Emphasized completing full antibiotic course.
encounters.lifestyle_advice: Warm saline gargles 3-4 times daily. Soft semi-solid diet.

encounters.chief_complaint: Seasonal allergic rhinitis, morning sneezing fits and bilateral watery nasal discharge.
encounters.diagnosis: Allergic Rhinitis with Mild Sinus Congestion
encounters.clinical_findings: Nasal turbinates pale and edematous. Oropharynx clear. Chest bilateral air entry equal.
encounters.doctor_notes: Prescribed non-sedating H1 antihistamine and steroid nasal spray. Advised allergen avoidance.
encounters.lifestyle_advice: Wear mask during outdoor farm chores. Avoid dust exposure.
